name: labs/nbush257__pyexpcontrol
title: nebPod NPX rig controller (nebPod.Controller)
intro: nebPod NPX rig controller (nebPod.Controller), adapted from nbush257/pyexpcontrol. It reads `valves`, `gpio` and `camera_triggering`; sets `laser_amplitude`; runs `set_valve`, `set_all_valves`, `set_gpio`, `start_camera_trigger` and 2 more. `set_valve`: open or close one olfactometer valve. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
